newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares power ahead in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares power ahead in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares continued firmer in active Tuesday trade but brokers urged investor caution, saying the bourse was headed for a price correction.
The main industrial index surged 105.88 points and broke through the 12,000 mark to close at a new all time high of 12,081.95.
"I don't know what will happen now but I still think we're headed for a correction and I would urge caution and selectivity in buying some of the shares," one broker said.
Counters to advance on Tuesday included tobacco company Rothmans which lept 500 cents to 5,000 while bankers FMB were 100 cents stronger at 4,600.

Hoteliers Zimsun put on 30 cents to 550, sugar growers Hippo and cement firm Circem were both up 25 cents to 1,825 and 595 respectively and clothing retailer Edgars put on 20 cents to 780. Tea and coffee growers EHPL at 290, and newspaper group Zimpapers at 160 both recorded 15-cent gains.

Minings were quiet and mixed with copper producers MCM and gold company Rio Tinto trading at previous levels while coal miners Wankie rose 25 cents to 825 and nickel producer Bindura slipped 10 cents to 570. The seven-share index there crept up 4.51 points to 871.01.
